config.name: Collector Diagnostics — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Collector Diagnostics
Technical dashboard for collector availability, JVM pressure, and collection/AD task health. Canonical single copy.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • Alive instance method mix?
  • JVM / CPU / heap pressure?
  • Slow or failing collection / AD tasks?
Recommended review flow
  1. Instance counts — Method mix
  2. JVM table + trends — Pressure
  3. Task graphs/tables — Slow / failing
  4. Collector alerts — Exceptions
Where to go next
  • Resource Health — 22
  • Active Alerts — 21
  • Technical Investigation — 30
Tip: Empty or zero values may mean healthy state or missing tokens/LogicModules — confirm before concluding.
